note: Only absent utilities whose exact class token is still named by a src string literal, template fragment or CSS selector, plus their missing theme tokens. Hits list the owning file/binding, its generator and source version; reachable is informational (rules are never dropped for it). Remove as owning modules migrate.

scanner.parser: rolldown/parseAst (ESTree) for scripts; postcss rule selectors for stylesheets
scanner.tokens: string Literal values and TemplateLiteral quasis (cooked), split on whitespace; CSS selector classes. Comments are not tokens.
scanner.retention: a rule is retained only when a referenced absent class is in its subject: the leading compound of each selector in its list, outside functional pseudo-class arguments (a selector led by :is()/:where() takes its argument's subject). Classes elsewhere in the selector are recorded as references but never retain it alone.

reachability.note: Per-hit reachable flag only; a rule held solely by unreachable modules is still retained.

hostDebt.note: Rules no earlier-version generated region holds: only host files name these dropped utilities. Not region migration debt; rewrite the host call sites to official 4.16336.0 classes/tokens.
